description: This file defines a PHP trait 'CryptoParamsTrait' within the 'Aws\S3\Crypto' namespace. The trait provides helper methods for handling cryptographic parameters, including retrieving materials providers, instruction file suffixes, determining get object strategies, and selecting metadata strategies related to AWS S3 client-side encryption.

methods.name: getMaterialsProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the materials provider from the method arguments, ensuring it is an instance of MaterialsProvider.

methods.name: getInstructionFileSuffix
methods.description: Returns the instruction file suffix from arguments or defaults to an internal value.

methods.name: determineGetObjectStrategy
methods.description: Determines and returns the appropriate strategy for getting an object based on its metadata.

methods.name: getMetadataStrategy
methods.description: Selects and returns the appropriate metadata strategy based on provided arguments and instruction file suffix.
